comment: Round-8 COARSE knots — the final SP layout. From the r7 layer-fit diagnostic: the d(age)/dz operator smears sub-decadal b(t) (null space), so dense b-knots collect noise. Coarse multidecadal b (15) matches what the layers actually constrain; sparse-deep/moderate-instrumental T (13). Paired with FIRN_SIG_DAGE_SCALE=2.2 (fine layer structure is unfittable), FIRN_B_CLIM=0.096 (de-biased, no ERA5, no seam), corrected datum (T_SHIFT=-5.8), k_snow pinned 1.29.
